narrative: This manifest plans the W4 journeys-linked audit for bugzilla-evergreen, a Bugzilla clone rebuilt as Banyan CQRS/Event Sourcing microservices. Seven user journeys are in scope (administer-products-components, bug-detail-review, bug-lifecycle-management, dashboard-personal-workflow, file-a-bug, manage-attachments-flags, search-and-filter-bugs), mapped against three cited workflows (workflow-bug-lifecycle, workflow-flag-review-approval, workflow-product-creation-saga) and eight SERVICE_SPEC.md files (service-attachment, service-bug, service-comment, service-notification, service-product, service-search, service-user). The canonical rule registry (audit-output/decision-rules.md) is not yet present on disk; slicers MUST mark all rule citations as [unciteable: TODO] until it appears. Every slicer must insert a 'Workflow & Rules Mapping' section (step-by-step mapping of journey steps to workflow gateways) and a 'Workflow & Rules Cross-References' section (structured table of workflow node → Rule ID → spec section). If a journey step cannot be mapped to any workflow gateway, the slicer marks it '[no clear mapping — manual review needed]'.

slices.title: Re-emit journey administer-products-components with workflow + rule cross-refs
slices.focus: Map product/component CRUD steps to workflow-product-creation-saga gateways (create, update, deactivation). Cite service-product Business Rules for validation and service-bug for product-in-use integrity checks. Also cite service-user for admin-permission rules.

slices.title: Re-emit journey bug-detail-review with workflow + rule cross-refs
slices.focus: This read-heavy journey views bug details, comments, attachments, and history. Map comment-add and status-change steps to workflow-bug-lifecycle gateways. Cite service-bug (field visibility, read-model projection rules), service-comment (comment CRUD rules), and service-attachment (attachment display rules).

slices.title: Re-emit journey bug-lifecycle-management with workflow + rule cross-refs
slices.focus: Primary lifecycle journey — every status transition (NEW → ASSIGNED → RESOLVED → VERIFIED → CLOSED) should map directly to workflow-bug-lifecycle gateways. Cite service-bug Business Rules for status transitions, resolution policies, and visibility. Cite service-comment for mandatory-comment rules on certain transitions, and service-notification for notification triggers.

slices.title: Re-emit journey dashboard-personal-workflow with workflow + rule cross-refs
slices.focus: Read-side dashboard journey — most steps (saved searches, my bugs, recent activity) are query-based and may not map to workflow gateways. Cite service-bug for bug-list projection rules, service-search for saved-search rules, and service-comment for recent-activity display. Slicer should mark un-mappable steps as '[no clear mapping — manual review needed]'.

slices.title: Re-emit journey file-a-bug with workflow + rule cross-refs
slices.focus: Map every step (Classification, Details, People & Tags, Review & Submit) to workflow-bug-lifecycle gateways (bug creation → initial status assignment → notification). Cite service-bug Business Rules for validation, field defaults, and permission checks. Also cite service-product for product/component validation and service-user for assignee/searchable-user rules.

slices.title: Re-emit journey manage-attachments-flags with workflow + rule cross-refs
slices.focus: Two workflows touch this journey: workflow-flag-review-approval (flag set/clear/review gateways) and workflow-bug-lifecycle (attachment branch). Cite service-attachment for upload/delete/display rules, service-bug for bug-context integrity, and service-comment for attachment-linked comment rules.

slices.title: Re-emit journey search-and-filter-bugs with workflow + rule cross-refs
slices.focus: Read-side journey — most steps (query construction, result display, saved searches) will not map to workflow gateways. Cite service-search query rules (full-text, field-based, saved-search CRUD) and service-bug field-visibility/permission rules. Slicer should mark un-mappable steps as '[no clear mapping — manual review needed]'. Include workflow-bug-lifecycle for any status-filter steps.
